result.rationale: Direct evidence resolves Chicago Parking Meters, Chicago Parking Meters, LLC and CPM to the existing production concessionaire and ParkChicago to its brand. The filed 2026 proposal identifies a contemplated Stonepeak acquisition and a proposal-date holder snapshot, but no direct cutoff source establishes an executed purchase agreement, final City action, executed consent, legal closing, current complete member register, retained or rolled interests, or Stonepeak as current owner. Preserve the approved MSIP, Allianz and ADIA display without treating it as new legal ownership evidence and make no database, seed or display change.

evidence.purpose: Direct filed evidence for the contemplated holder and transfer structure and the limits of the proposal-stage record.
